# `<snprintf.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Bounded formatted output.

```c
#include <snprintf.h>
```

## Functions

### `snprintf` { #snprintf }

```c
int snprintf(char *buf, size_t size, const char *fmt,...);
```

Formats into a buffer, C99-style.

Writes at most `size` - 1 characters and a NUL. With `size` 0 nothing is written. Safe to nest: each call keeps its own state.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `buf` | out | Output buffer. |
| `size` | in | Size of `buf`. |
| `fmt` | in | printf format. |
| `...` | in | Arguments. |

**Returns:** The length the full output would have, excluding the NUL, even when truncated.

### `vsnprintf` { #vsnprintf }

```c
int vsnprintf(char *buf, size_t size, const char *fmt, va_list args);
```

snprintf() taking a va_list.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `buf` | out | Output buffer. |
| `size` | in | Size of `buf`. |
| `fmt` | in | printf format. |
| `args` | in | Arguments. |

**Returns:** As snprintf().
